envelope.summary: Round 2: both blocking findings from round 1 are fixed. REQ-4/AC-14 now make the socket address the rate-limit key by default, and REQ-9/AC-15 now require a confirmation before Reset score discards a pending result. All five dimensions pass, and the counterexample is rejected or only uses behavior the request does not cover. Two non-blocking advisories are left for the builder.

findings.problem: Fixed in round 2. REQ-4 now says the key is the socket address and that X-Forwarded-For is ignored unless trustProxy is explicitly configured (default off). It has a 'Forged forwarding header' scenario. AC-14 requires 429 on the 11th save from one socket address, even when every request carries a different X-Forwarded-For value, with only 10 stored results. design.md keeps trustProxy off by default. This matches current code: src/server/app.ts:5 calls Fastify({ logger: false }) with no trustProxy. The round-1 counterexample (trustProxy: true) now fails AC-14.

Fixed in round 2. REQ-9 now covers every action that would discard the finished round: New round and Reset score. It has declined, confirmed and no-pending Reset score scenarios, and AC-15 makes them observable. In the repo, Reset score always renders (src/ui/App.tsx:54-61) and resetScore replaces the round (src/domain/session.ts:131-133). Those are the only two discarding actions. changeSettings only changes settings and leaves round.result alone (src/domain/session.ts:82-85). The round-1 counterexample now fails AC-15.

Advisory. When a round is over, settings are unlocked (src/domain/session.ts:69-71, 82-85), so the player can switch difficulty while a result is pending. If the save form reads difficulty from session.settings instead of round.result.difficulty (src/domain/session.ts:20-25, 64), a Hard win can be saved as Easy. No AC pins which difficulty is sent. A related risk: if the pending or saved flag is local state of a component that unmounts when the leaderboard screen opens, the pending result can be lost or saved twice. AC-8 checks only that the board and score are unchanged.
findings.expected_fix: Builder: take difficulty and outcome from round.result (the domain outcome mapping), not from current settings. Keep the pending and saved state in App or a hook that survives opening the leaderboard, and add a test for each case.

findings.problem: Advisory. .gitignore currently ignores data/*.db, *.sqlite and similar patterns, but not the whole data/ directory. AC-9 requires 'data/ is ignored by git', and proposal.md says data/ is excluded. A database file name that matches none of these patterns (e.g. data/results) would be committed.
findings.expected_fix: Builder: add 'data/' to .gitignore and check it with git check-ignore in the planned gitignore-check evidence.

payload.counterexample: Simplest wrong implementations tried. (1) buildApp creates Fastify with trustProxy: true, so each forged X-Forwarded-For gets a fresh bucket: rejected by AC-14. (2) Confirmation only on New round, while Reset score silently clears the pending result: rejected by AC-15. (3) The API returns all rows and the client sorts and slices to 20: rejected by AC-6, which checks GET /api/leaderboard directly. (4) Grouping by exact nickname: rejected by AC-6 ('Ann' and 'ann' are one player). Remaining gap, outside explicit criteria and non-blocking (F-3): the save sends the current settings difficulty instead of the finished round's difficulty after the player changes difficulty while the result is pending. This is a correctness edge case the request does not name, and it is forwarded to the builder as an advisory.
